title: VERY SMALL BLANKET
text: VERY SMALL BLANKET. I bought this for my bed for my medium size terrier to cuddle with and to protect my bedding from hair, dust, dog dander etc. Way to small, so I put it in her doggie bed in the living room rather than waste time returning it. BUY SOMETHING ELSE if you need a larger blanket.
